functions.name: inspect
functions.description: Open the native docked DevTools toolbox for the tab whose URL matches (same-tab, like the native Inspect Element). When 'mark' is given, selects the element carrying [data-rozelynx-inspect="<mark>"] in the inspector (tool=inspector) or its accessible object in the accessibility panel (tool=accessibility).

url.description: Current URL spec of the tab to inspect (matched exactly against the tab's currentURI).

mark.description: Optional data-rozelynx-inspect attribute value set on the target element by the content script.
